confined_rerecorded.why: a restricted codex thread starts under the sparrow_restricted permissions profile and without the `sandbox` param, which would win over the profile (thread/start config and params; the stub's echo of the thread's sandbox, and so the result's length, follow). The two macOS-only /tmp deny rules are left out by the driver so the recording is one for every host; with those changes removed the recording equals the previous one

no_integrations_rerecorded.why: a restricted codex thread first reads the effective config (config/read) and starts with every MCP server it names disabled, web search off and the connector features off (thread/start config); with that call and key removed the recording equals the previous one

recorded_because: lock refusal text changed by the single-flock contract (lock note v6 §1.2 lines); chars compared by value; routine and Codex behaviour otherwise unchanged
